userStories.title: Create JS module infrastructure and api.js
userStories.description:
Current state: website/index.html is a 1642-line monolith with all JS functions as globals.

What to build:
1. Create website/js/ directory
2. Create website/js/api.js as an ES module. It contains all HTTP fetch calls to the API, zero DOM, zero global state.

Functions to extract from index.html into api.js:
- API_BASE constant (= window.location.origin + '/api')
- CONTEXT_API_BASE constant (= API_BASE + '/context')
- searchChunks(query, {top_k, collection, provenance}) — calls POST /api/query or POST /api/query-provable
- fetchContextNav(docId, chunkIndex, collection, windowSize) — calls GET /api/context with query params
- fetchZKProof(docId, chunkId, collection) — calls POST /api/provenance/prove
- submitProof({proof_hex, public_inputs_hex, vk_hex}) — calls POST /api/provenance/submit
- getProofStatus(jobId) — calls GET /api/provenance/status/{job_id}

Auth: each function reads the global `apiKey` variable (set elsewhere in index.html) and adds 'Authorization: Bearer ' + apiKey to headers if set.

Each function returns the parsed JSON. Throws on non-OK response.

Do NOT wire any events, do NOT touch DOM, do NOT create global state.
acceptanceCriteria: python3 -m py_compile $REPO_DIR/website/js/api.js exits 0 2>&1 || echo 'js file - skip py compile'
qualityChecks: grep -c 'document\|innerHTML\|addEventListener\|querySelector' $REPO_DIR/website/js/api.js || echo '0 DOM calls in api.js'
contextFiles: website/index.html (lines 888-913: fetchContextNav and fetchZKProof — use as reference for request/response shapes)

userStories.title: Create state.js — in-memory state module
userStories.description:
Current state: _allResults, _loadedDocCount, _zkCache, _lastSearchWasProvenance, PAGE_SIZE are global variables in index.html.

What to build:
Create website/js/state.js as an ES module with pure getter/setter functions for all in-memory state.

State variables:
- _allResults: array (full result set from last search)
- _loadedDocCount: number (how many doc groups currently shown)
- _zkCache: object keyed by chunkId (proof data: {proof_hex, vk_hex, public_inputs_hex, public_inputs, evm_block_number, job_id, explorer_url, tx_hash, tx_explorer_url, block_hash, block_explorer_url})
- _lastSearchWasProvenance: boolean
- PAGE_SIZE: number = 3

Exported functions:
- getResults() → _allResults
- setResults(results, provenance) → sets _allResults and _lastSearchWasProvenance
- getLoadedDocCount() → _loadedDocCount
- incrementLoadedDocCount(n) → _loadedDocCount += n, returns new value
- resetLoadedDocCount() → _loadedDocCount = 0
- getZkCache() → _zkCache
- cacheZkProof(chunkId, proofData) → _zkCache[chunkId] = {...existing, ...proofData}
- cacheVerificationResult(chunkId, verificationData) → merge verification fields into _zkCache[chunkId]
- getChunkById(chunkId) → finds and returns chunk from _allResults where chunk.chunk_id === chunkId
- getLastSearchWasProvenance() → boolean
- isProvenanceMode() → _lastSearchWasProvenance

No fetch calls, no DOM access. Pure state.
acceptanceCriteria: grep -c 'fetch\|document\|innerHTML' $REPO_DIR/website/js/state.js | grep -q '^0$' && echo 'PASS: no DOM/fetch in state.js'

userStories.title: Create renderer.js — pure HTML builder functions
userStories.description:
Current state: _buildDocGroupHtml, buildPassageCard, wireZKButtons are global functions in index.html (lines 603-800+). They build HTML strings and manipulate DOM. What to build: Create website/js/renderer.js as an ES module. It exports pure functions that return HTML strings. Zero fetch, zero DOM side-effects. Required exports: - escapeHtml(str) → escapes & < > " ' — move from index.html - extractPages(text, currentPage) → from index.html line 580-602 area — extracts page numbers from text - buildLoadMoreButton(remainingDocCount) → '
...
' string - buildDocGroupHtml(docId, passages, allResults) → full HTML for one document's group. References index.html lines 603-655 for exact field mapping (title, metadata, passage cards, etc.) - buildPassageCard(chunk, zkProof, isProvenanceSearch) → HTML for a single passage card with nav buttons and ZK proof button. References index.html lines 916-953 for exact structure. The zkProof button appears if zkProof && zkProof.proof_hex. - buildResultsHtml(state) → full results HTML: doc groups + load-more button. state has: results, loadedDocCount, docGroups (derived), remaining. - buildLoadMoreHtml(remainingDocCount) → just the load-more button wrapper HTML wireNewCard(cardElement, chunk) → DOM side-effect function (exception to pure). It attaches ZK expand button listener and image loader to a newly inserted card element. Takes the DOM node, not a string. Copy the exact HTML structure from index.html for each builder function. The chunk fields are: doc_id, chunk_id, chunk_index, collection, page, text, score, metadata (with title, doc_type, branch, pub_year, page_count), ia_identifier, ia_url, evm_block_number, zk_proof (if provenance search).
qualityChecks: grep -c 'fetch\|XMLHttpRequest' $REPO_DIR/website/js/renderer.js | grep -q '^0$' && echo 'PASS: no network in renderer'

userStories.title: Create app.js — orchestration actions
userStories.description:
Current state: performSearch() (lines 657-751) is a monolithic function doing API call + state update + rendering + event wiring all at once. event-delegation handler at lines 1008-1060 handles nav and load-more with entangled logic.

What to build:
Create website/js/app.js as an ES module. It imports api.js and state.js and renderer.js. It exports async action functions called by event handlers.

Required exports:
- handleSearch(query, provenance): calls api.searchChunks → state.setResults → renderer.buildResultsHtml → sets resultsContainer.innerHTML → calls wireZKButtons() on new cards
- handleLoadMore(): reads state.getLoadedDocCount() → state.incrementLoadedDocCount(PAGE_SIZE) → builds new doc groups HTML → insertAdjacentHTML → wireNewCard on each new card → update/replace load-more button text
- handleNavProvenance(docId, chunkId, chunkIndex, collection, direction): calls api.fetchContextNav(docId, chunkIndex+direction, collection, 0) → api.fetchZKProof(docId, chunkId, collection) → state.cacheZkProof → renderer.buildPassageCard → replace card in DOM
- handleNavPlain(docId, chunkId, chunkIndex, collection, direction): calls api.fetchContextNav → replace card, no ZK proof
- handleVerifyOnChain(chunkId): reads state.getZkCache()[chunkId] → api.submitProof → poll with api.getProofStatus → state.cacheVerificationResult

All functions read the global `resultsContainer` DOM element (defined in index.html) for DOM manipulation.

wireZKButtons() from index.html lines 756-800 should be moved to app.js as a local function called after each render. It handles the cloneNode pattern for ZK button listeners.
contextFiles: website/index.html (lines 657-751: performSearch — primary reference for handleSearch logic)
website/index.html (lines 1527-1628: load-more handler — reference for handleLoadMore)
website/index.html (lines 1015-1053: nav+provenance handler — reference for handleNavProvenance)

userStories.title: Create event-handlers.js — event listener registration
userStories.description:
Current state: index.html has all event listeners registered inline (search button click, search input keypress, load-more delegated click, nav delegated click). Lines 1485-1525 approximately.

What to build:
Create website/js/event-handlers.js as an ES module. It imports app.js action functions and registers all event listeners on the page.

Required registrations:
- search button click → app.handleSearch(searchInput.value, false)
- search (provenance) button click → app.handleSearch(searchInput.value, true)
- search input keypress Enter → app.handleSearch(searchInput.value, false)
- resultsContainer delegated click → route to handleLoadMore (if id=loadMoreBtn) or handleNav (if nav button)

Delegated click handler reads e.target.closest('.chunk-nav-btn') to find the button, then reads dataset.action, docId, chunkId, chunkIndex, collection from the closest .passage-card.

Delegated click also handles: .load-more-btn → app.handleLoadMore().

The searchProvenanceBtn reference comes from: document.getElementById('searchProvenanceBtn') — same as current code.

No api calls, no DOM building. Pure event wiring.
contextFiles: website/index.html (lines 1485-1525: event listener registration — reference for what to wire)

userStories.title: Refactor index.html to import JS modules
userStories.description:
Current state: index.html contains all ~1640 lines of JS as a single <script> block.

What to build:
Split the JS into ES modules. Keep the HTML, CSS, and the ZK submenu/verification UI (inline JS that uses api.js and state.js) intact.

Steps:
1. Add <script type="module"> tags inside <head> or before </body> that import the 4 module files:
   <script type="module">
     import './js/api.js';
     import './js/state.js';
     import './js/renderer.js';
     import './js/app.js';
     import './js/event-handlers.js';
   </script>

2. Remove ALL JavaScript functions from the inline <script> block EXCEPT:
   - The ZK submenu and verification functions that reference _zkCache: _buildSubmenu, _downloadProof, _verifyOnChain, _showHowItWorksModal, showProvenanceModal, closeProvenanceModal, showResultsModal
   - The provenances-modal HTML (lines 567-573)
   - The zk-submenu HTML builder
   - These need access to state._zkCache and api.js functions — import them at the top of the inline script

3. Remove: performSearch, _buildDocGroupHtml, fetchContextNav, fetchZKProof, buildPassageCard, wireZKButtons, all event listener registrations, global state variables (_allResults, _loadedDocCount, _zkCache, PAGE_SIZE, _lastSearchWasProvenance).

4. Keep global variables needed by the inline ZK UI: apiKey, _zkCache (import from state.js instead), showProvenanceModal, closeProvenanceModal, showResultsModal.

5. The provenances-modal HTML and the ZK submenu/inline JS stay in index.html exactly as they are now.

6. The inline ZK script should start with:
   <script type="module">
     import { _zkCache, cacheZkProof, cacheVerificationResult, getZkCache } from './js/state.js';
     import * as api from './js/api.js';
     // ... existing ZK functions unchanged, just use api.fetchZKProof etc.
   </script>

CAUTION: Test carefully. The ZK functions call api.submitProof and api.getProofStatus and api.fetchZKProof. These must continue to work.
acceptanceCriteria: grep -c '<script type="module"' $REPO_DIR/website/index.html | grep -q '^1$' && echo 'PASS: exactly one module script tag'
qualityChecks: grep -c 'function performSearch\|function _buildDocGroupHtml\|function fetchContextNav' $REPO_DIR/website/index.html | grep -q '^0$' && echo 'PASS: old functions removed from index.html'
contextFiles: website/index.html (lines 1119-1200: ZK submenu functions — keep but convert to module import)
website/index.html (lines 1320-1490: inline JS — review each line for what to keep vs remove)

userStories.title: Write JS unit tests for api.js, state.js, renderer.js
userStories.description:
Current state: No JS unit tests exist.

What to build:
Create website/js/api.test.js, website/js/state.test.js, website/js/renderer.test.js using Vitest.

api.test.js tests:
- searchChunks with provenance=false calls POST /api/query with correct body
- searchChunks with provenance=true calls POST /api/query-provable
- fetchContextNav builds correct URL with query params
- fetchZKProof calls POST /api/provenance/prove with correct body
- Non-OK responses throw an error

Use: import { vi } from 'vitest'; globalThis.fetch = vi.fn(); after each test reset with fetch.mockReset().

state.test.js tests:
- setResults stores results and provenance flag
- getChunkById returns correct chunk
- cacheZkProof merges into existing cache entry
- incrementLoadedDocCount returns new value
- isProvenanceMode returns correct boolean

renderer.test.js tests:
- buildDocGroupHtml with 1 doc + 2 passages returns HTML containing both passage cards
- buildDocGroupHtml with empty passages returns empty string
- buildPassageCard with zkProof containing proof_hex includes ZK button HTML
- buildPassageCard with null zkProof does NOT include ZK button HTML
- buildLoadMoreButton with 5 remaining includes '5 more documents'
- escapeHtml escapes < > & " correctly
- extractPages returns array of page numbers from text

Use Vitest. Config: website/js/vitest.config.js (or package.json with vitest config).

Install vitest as dev dependency if needed: npm install --save-dev vitest in website/js/.

userStories.title: Write Playwright integration tests for load-more and provenance nav
userStories.description:
Current state: No Playwright tests for the website.

What to build:
Create tests/test_website_integration.py with Playwright tests.

Requirements:
- Uses Playwright (python). Launches browser against the website served at http://127.0.0.1:80 (website is already served by OpenResty/nginx on port 80).
- Before running tests, ensure the website and API are running. Tests can assume port 80 and 8100 are up.

tests/test_website_integration.py:

test_load_more_button_appends_docs():
1. Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:80/
2. Type a query in search box and click Search (or press Enter)
3. Wait for results to appear (.passage-card elements present)
4. Count visible .document-header elements
5. Click Load More button
6. Wait for new cards
7. Assert: total .document-header count increased by PAGE_SIZE (or remaining if fewer)
8. Assert: first 3 doc headers still present (no reload)

test_provenance_nav_fetches_zk_proof():
1. Search with provenance=true
2. Wait for results with ZK buttons
3. Click Next+Provenance on first card
4. Wait for new card to appear
5. Assert: new .zk-expand-btn is present on the new card

test_load_more_does_not_reload_existing_buttons():
1. Search (not provenance)
2. Click first ZK expand button (or wait for it — may not be present without provenance)
3. Load More
4. Assert: the first ZK expand button from step 2 is still functional (or absent if not provenance search)

test_zk_proof_download_button():
1. Search with provenance
2. Click ZK expand button on first result
3. Verify submenu opens
4. Click download button
5. Verify download was triggered (check page triggered download)

Each test: use playwright.sync_playwright() as context manager. Use page.goto(), page.fill(), page.click(), page.wait_for_selector(), page.wait_for_function().
contextFiles: website/index.html (full — for understanding current UI structure)
